pre_condition: state is a populated State instance.
post_condition: Returns a Rich Panel renderable with cyan border containing a single line of text. The line joins four parts separated by " • ": (a) the dashboard title "FM-Agent Dashboard" in bold cyan; (b) the workdir path from state.workdir labeled "workdir:"; (c) the model identifier from state.model_seen (or "?" if the value is empty) labeled "model:"; and (d) the elapsed time from state.elapsed() formatted as a human-readable duration string labeled "elapsed:". The state argument is not mutated by this call.
